recognize_zh: G 帶染色核型圖標示 46,XX,t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)：箭頭指出 9 號染色體長臂多出一段（der(9)）與明顯變短的 22 號染色體（Philadelphia chromosome），即 BCR-ABL1 融合的細胞遺傳學證據。
features: G-banded karyotype of a female cell (XX) with 46 chromosomes
Arrow on one chromosome 9 showing an altered, lengthened 9q (der(9)) from the reciprocal translocation
Arrow on one chromosome 22 showing a shortened 22q, the Philadelphia chromosome (der(22))
No additional numerical abnormalities evident in this cell
describe_en: This G-banded karyogram shows a female karyotype with 46 chromosomes and a balanced reciprocal translocation between the long arms of chromosomes 9 and 22 at bands q34 and q11.2, designated 46,XX,t(9;22)(q34;q11.2). The arrows highlight the derivative chromosome 9 and the shortened derivative chromosome 22 (Philadelphia chromosome), which carries the BCR-ABL1 fusion gene. No additional clonal abnormalities are apparent in this metaphase. In the setting of B-lymphoblastic leukemia, this finding defines B-ALL with t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2); BCR-ABL1, an entity that usually expresses the p190 fusion transcript and is treated with tyrosine kinase inhibitors.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in lymphoid blast phase
ddx.vs: Carries the same translocation; separation relies on history of a chronic phase, p210 transcript, splenomegaly and BCR-ABL1 in myeloid lineages rather than on the karyotype.
Ph-like ALL has a similar gene-expression profile and kinase-activating lesions (e.g., CRLF2, ABL-class fusions) but lacks t(9;22) and BCR-ABL1 by FISH/RT-PCR.

ddx.dx: Mixed phenotype acute leukemia with t(9;22)
ddx.vs: Requires flow cytometric evidence of both B and myeloid (MPO) lineage in the blasts.
